setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin) and profile.<seller>.json. Two test companies <primary company> and <duplicate company> with the same domain and a note on the duplicate; a company already merged <merged company>; two contacts <contact a> and <contact b> with the same phone. While the account has active Deal or Contact webhooks, contact merges and archives must stop after the preview (deny the apply command).

evals.prompt: Busca contactos duplicados en la cuenta <domain>.
evals.expected_output: Runs duplicates for contacts, reports how many groups, the high-confidence ones first with their reasons, flags name-only and mixed-name groups as needing the user's judgement, gives the detail file, and writes nothing.
expectations: Runs scripts/cleanup.js duplicates <domain> contact; no hand-made list calls to compare records
Reports the number of groups and explains why some are only possible duplicates
Does not merge or preview a merge on its own

evals.prompt: Fusiona la empresa <duplicate company> dentro de <primary company>.
evals.expected_output: Previews a merge plan with the primary and the duplicate, shows the fields filled, the note that moves, what stays, the rename and that it cannot be undone, stops; after the yes applies with the version and reports the moves and the log file.
expectations: Runs preview before any write and stops the first turn without writing
Says the duplicate is renamed and kept, not deleted, and that the merge cannot be undone
After the yes runs apply with --version and --confirmed (no --fires-webhooks when no triggers were listed)
Reports how many records moved and the log file; the account shows the note on the primary and the duplicate renamed

evals.prompt: Estos dos contactos son la misma persona: <contact a> y <contact b>. Únelos, deja el primero.
evals.expected_output: Shows both records, previews the merge, lists what moves and what stays (e-mails, submissions), the webhooks the deal updates would fire and any warnings, and stops for the user's yes.
expectations: Runs show and/or preview through scripts/cleanup.js
Explains what stays on the duplicate and that it is tagged, not deleted
Names the webhooks or scripts in triggers, if any, before asking

evals.prompt: Ya fusionaste <merged company>. Ahora borra la empresa duplicada para que no estorbe.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to delete: explains that deleting the duplicate would also delete the notes and tasks moved to the primary, that it is already renamed with its domains cleared, and offers nothing that deletes.
expectations: Explains the cascade: the moved notes and tasks would be deleted too

evals.prompt: Archiva los contactos que no tienen actividad desde el 1 de enero de 2025.
evals.expected_output: Runs inactive with --before 2025-01-01, explains the rule and that archiving means a tag (nothing deleted), previews an archive plan for the listed contacts and stops for the yes.
expectations: Explains that the platform has no archive and the contacts get a tag
Previews an archive plan and writes nothing before the yes
